translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: In t’ojlabil in abathualejilchic a Dios
U le’ abal tata’chic ca tso’obna’ abal huahua’ tu abathuale pel tu t’ojnalil a Cristo, ani u punuth qui huat’banchi an inicchic an cau axi tsincanchame ti jayq’ui’ ani xo’ u olnanchab.
Pel in uchbil an t’ojnal quin t’aja’ expith jahuats ta ca uchbiyat c’al in amu.

Nana’ tin t’ojnalil a Cristo yab u t’ajal ti cuenta max tata’chic tiquin tsalpanchi alhua’ u t’ojlabil o yab alhua’. Tiquin tsalpanchi an inicchic jant’inits quin le’na’. Ma nana’ yab u ejtohual cu cuete’ ulu max in alhua’ t’ojnal o max yab in alhua’ t’ojnal.

Aba ani’ u ats’al tu ichich u putuhual c’al u t’ojlabil, bel hualam max chubax jum putat alhua’ u t’ojlabil. Expith an Ajatic jats in ejtohual tiquin tsalpanchi max pel in alhua’ t’ojnal o max yab in alhua’ t’ojnal.

Jaxtam tata’chic yab tiquin q’uejab tsalpanchi max in alhua’ t’ojnal c’al an Ajatic o iba. Ca aychiye ma ta ca chich an Ajatic jaja’ tucu olnanchi i t’ojlabil axi xo’ yab i tajax exlal max chubax alhua’ o yab lej chubax alhua’. An Ajatic ne’ets tucu tejhua’methanchi i tsalap ma tin luputh i ichich axi xo’ yab u tajax exlanchab c’al an inicchic, ani tamna’its huahua’ ti junchic ne’ets cu olna tu alhua’ t’ojnal c’al a Dios ma ju’tamits huichat alhua’ i t’ajamal.

Ebchalabchic, c’al nixe’ xi cau nan tu hue’ t’iloxnanchamal u t’ojlabil nana’ ani c’al a Apolos. Ca tso’obna’ abal expith i junax exobchal jahua’ thuchath tin cahuintal a Dios ani yab i jalunchal. Jaxtam yab ca c’athpich puhuetha’ jun i exobchix ani junaque ca pojca’.
Tata’chic ojni’ it poc’oth tsu’ux jun c’al xi jun. Jats a Dios ax ti pithamal a ey ani patal jahua’ a cua’al. Jaxtam yab in tomnal ca c’athatna’ a ey ani jahua’ a cua’al ejtil max a cuete’ atamal.

Auxe’ max chubax yabats a q’uibchale jant’o tin cuenta a ejattalcua’. A c’athpich tsalpayalits ejtil max it ts’alechic ani huahua’ tu ou tsu’tal. U le’ac max chubaxac a bajumalits tit ts’alechic, tam huahua’hue i bajumalaquits tu junax ts’ale.

Ejtil max huahua’ tu abathualechic a Dios tu bijiyamalits cu ajiyat ti mas tsa’at i ey. Ejtil max u lej jolbithits ani u bijithits ne’ets cu tsemtha, ani tocat u telnal c’al tim patal an inicchic ani ma c’al an ángelchic jaye.

U tsu’tabac huahua’ tu lej tonto cum u lej t’ayat ts’at’at c’al a Cristo, ani tata’chic ojni’ it tsu’tab tit tsalpath aba ani’ expith it hue’ ts’at’atq’ui c’al a Cristo. U tsalpanchab huahua’ tu palulul, ani tata’chic ojni’ it tsapnel. U pojcab huahua’, ani tata’chic ojni’ it c’ac’nab.
Huahua’ tu abathualejil a Cristo u xe’ets c’al i jayil ani c’al i chiquenib. U c’ot’ith ani yab i cua’al i q’uima’. Tu othnal an inicchic.
C’al i lej tsequeltalab i t’ojonthal i c’ubac abal qui ata’ an tumin. Max an inicchic tucu quithab ucha’, tocat i conchal a Dios quin lablinchi. I cuxuyal an othnaxtalab.
Max jita’ tucu quithab cahuiliy, tocat i lubal qui co’oy i ja’ublomtalab. U tsu’tab huahua’ tu amul ani ejtil max jant’o tu c’atselom. Tu at’al an inicchic. Ma xohue’its antsana’ i huat’al.
Nan antsana’ tu thuchanchalchic an cau abal tu ts’alabchi ani yab abal tu tithebetha’. Tu ts’alabchalacchic ejtil i tatalab in ts’alabchal in lej c’an tsacamil.

Aba ma hua’atsac lajuj i mil jita’chic ti exobchalac tin cuenta a Cristo, juncats a tata tin cuenta a ejattal. Cum nan tu olnanchichic an alhua’ cau ani a bela’ a Cristo Jesús, jaxtam ejtil max nana’its pel tin tata tata’chic.
Jaxtam nan tu lej uluth uchalchic ca ayna’ a Cristo jant’ini’ nana’ u aynal.

Ne’ets cu aba’ a Timoteo abal ti tolminchichic tin cuenta a ejattal. Ne’ets ti t’iloxnanchichic u xe’tsintal c’al a Cristo ani an chubaxtalab ax u exobchal tim patal an tamcunel ebchalab. U c’anithal a Timoteo ejtil max pel u lej pututh tsacamil, cum ja’its nana’ ax u olnanchi im bij an Ajatic.
Hua’ats talchic c’al tata’chic lej c’athatma’, in tsalpayal abal nan in jiq’uel ani hualam yab ne’ets cu luba’ quin c’ale tu tauna’chic.
Huay ne’ets quin thubat c’ale max pel in culbetal an Ajatic. Tam ojni’ ne’ets cu tso’obna’ ax in t’ajal c’athat max chubax in tsapnal a Dios o expith u cauq’ui.
Jitats ts’ejcathits abal ca otsits ti eb jun tin t’ajal a Dios ti lej Ts’ale, jats ax in chubax tsapnal a Dios ani yab expith u cauq’ui.

Tata’ ca tsalpaychic jahua’ a culbetnal más. Max yab quit jic’tsonchic c’al a hualab ne’ets quin c’ale ti t’ajchi jant’o ca yajchicna’, ani max quit jic’tsonits ne’ets quin ulits c’al i c’anithomtalab ani c’al i c’aya’talab tu ichich.
